fieldData.acrm---key-feature-1-content:
The questions a front desk needs

Asks for the visitor's name and company, then the host from a dropdown list. The form stamps the time in, and a returning visitor's details fill in from their email address.
fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Sam Keller hears about his visitor in Slack

Visitors at Fieldstone Architects sign in on a tablet in the lobby. Lena Ortiz types her name and company, picks Sam Keller from the host list, and taps Sign in. Sam gets a Slack direct message at 2:04 PM naming her and Northwind Freight, and he walks out to meet her.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Buyers without an agent make the follow-up list

Linden Realty holds an open house at 18 Alder Lane on a Sunday afternoon. Each group signs in at the door and says whether they already work with an agent. In all, 14 groups came through, and the five with no agent reach listing agent Dana Whitfield by email at 5:00 PM.
